title: Exercise pool
description: Exercises shipped with the app (backend/exercise-pools/*.json). Kids draw their daily exercises from the pools written for their grade; a pool listing their grade under revision fills a category their grade has nothing in

grades.description: The school grades this pool is written for (Δημοτικό: 1 = Α' … 6 = ΣΤ')

revision.description: Grades this pool serves as revision: only for a category (Μαθηματικά, Γλώσσα, …) that the grade's own pools have nothing in. Not one of `grades`
